node.title: Re: Pass local bash script to remote host via SSH (updated)
node.author: soonix
node.doctext:
use strict; use warnings; open(my $out_fh, "|-", qw'ssh bash -s') or die "Can't start ssh: $!"; print$out_fh < EOF close $out_fh or die "Error flushing/closing pipe to ssh: $!"; see [doc://open], and [doc://perlop#Quote-and-Quote-like-Operators] (watch the semicolon after < - the < syntactically stands in for the complete string)

Update:should you need variables interpolated in your 'ssh ...', you need to create the list in a different way, because [doc://qw] doesn't interpolate variables.
